headlines.text: Rewind to 2023, when a new chapter began as Eddie Kingston vs. Jon Moxley fought for the brand-new AEW Continental Title, appearing on Worlds End, rated 8.14 ? an excellent showing. In the tournament final of the inaugural Continental Classic, Kingston defeated Moxley to become the first-ever American Triple Crown Champion, unifying the AEW Continental, ROH World, and NJPW Strong Openweight Titles.

On this day in 2020, Proud-N-Powerful & MJF kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 9.17 ? a match fans still talk about. Part of AEW's deeply emotional "Celebration of Life" episode for Brodie Lee, with Brodie Jr. wearing a Dark Order mask and cheering ringside ? MJF played the perfect heel foil throughout the night's tribute matches, a poignant moment even amid the storyline mischief.

On a Friday in 2022, back when Orange Cassidy vs. Trent Beretta clashed for the AEW All-Atlantic Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.30 ? a well-worked match. Orange Cassidy was chasing gold for the 10th time. Best Friends collided as Cassidy defended the All-Atlantic Title against his own stablemate Trent, who stormed off unable to hide his frustration after the loss.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2023, when the AEW TNT Title changed hands as Adam Copeland vs. Christian Cage battled it out in a No DQ match, appearing on Worlds End, rated 8.37 ? a genuinely great match ? ending the champion's reign at 5 defenses. In a No DQ match filled with tables, ladders and Shayna Wayne interference, Copeland speared Cage through a table to win his first title in over a decade ? only to lose it right back moments later when Killswitch's contract loophole let Cage steal it with a Spear of his own.

On this day in 2023, gold changed shoulders as the AEW World Heavyweight Title found a new champion as Samoa Joe vs. MJF battled it out, appearing on Worlds End, rated 7.05 ? a solid showing ? ending the champion's reign at 11 defenses. Samoa Joe choked out a battered MJF to end his 400-plus-day reign and win the AEW World Championship, as Adam Cole's unmasking as The Devil loomed over the entire match.

On this day in 2023, Claudio Castagnoli chalked up their 50th recorded AEW match ? a genuine milestone, facing Castagnoli & Danielson vs. Bryan Danielson vs. Claudio Castagnoli vs. Daniel Garcia vs. Mark Briscoe vs. Brody King vs. Jay Lethal vs. Jay White vs. Rush, getting things started right out of the gate on Worlds End, rated 7.32 ? a strong outing, part of the special Worlds End '23 card.
